device.description: 16-bit I2C I/O expander with interrupt output

registers.description: Pin direction. 1 = input, 0 = output. All pins are inputs after reset. (port A)
registers.name: IODIRA

registers.description: Pin direction. 1 = input, 0 = output. All pins are inputs after reset. (port B)
registers.name: IODIRB

registers.description: Input polarity. 1 = the GPIO register reflects the inverted pin value. (port A)
registers.name: IPOLA

registers.description: Input polarity. 1 = the GPIO register reflects the inverted pin value. (port B)
registers.name: IPOLB

registers.description: Interrupt-on-change enable, per pin (port A)
registers.name: GPINTENA

registers.description: Interrupt-on-change enable, per pin (port B)
registers.name: GPINTENB

registers.description: Default comparison value, used when INTCON selects comparison mode (port A)
registers.name: DEFVALA

registers.description: Default comparison value, used when INTCON selects comparison mode (port B)
registers.name: DEFVALB

registers.description: Interrupt control. 1 = compare against DEFVAL, 0 = compare against the previous value. (port A)
registers.name: INTCONA

registers.description: Interrupt control. 1 = compare against DEFVAL, 0 = compare against the previous value. (port B)
registers.name: INTCONB

registers.description: Device configuration, shared by both ports. Also readable and writable at 0x0B; the two addresses are the same physical register.

fields.description: Register addressing mode. 0 = A/B registers interleaved (the mapping transcribed here), 1 = ports in separate banks.
fields.name: BANK

fields.description: 1 = INTA and INTB are internally connected
fields.name: MIRROR

fields.description: Sequential operation disable. 1 = the address pointer does not increment.
fields.name: SEQOP

fields.description: Hardware address enable. No effect on the I2C part; present for the SPI variant.
fields.name: HAEN

fields.description: 1 = INT pin is open drain, overriding INTPOL
fields.name: ODR

fields.description: INT pin polarity when ODR is 0. 0 = active low, 1 = active high.
fields.name: INTPOL

registers.name: IOCON

registers.description: 100 kOhm pull-up enable, per pin, on pins configured as inputs (port A)
registers.name: GPPUA

registers.description: 100 kOhm pull-up enable, per pin, on pins configured as inputs (port B)
registers.name: GPPUB

registers.description: Interrupt flags. 1 = this pin caused the interrupt. Read-only. (port A)
registers.name: INTFA

registers.description: Interrupt flags. 1 = this pin caused the interrupt. Read-only. (port B)
registers.name: INTFB

registers.description: Port value captured at the time of the interrupt. Cleared by reading INTCAP or GPIO. (port A)
registers.name: INTCAPA

registers.description: Port value captured at the time of the interrupt. Cleared by reading INTCAP or GPIO. (port B)
registers.name: INTCAPB

registers.description: Port value. Reading returns the pin state; writing modifies the output latch. (port A)
registers.name: GPIOA

registers.description: Port value. Reading returns the pin state; writing modifies the output latch. (port B)
registers.name: GPIOB

registers.description: Output latch. Reading returns the latch, not the pin. (port A)
registers.name: OLATA

registers.description: Output latch. Reading returns the latch, not the pin. (port B)
registers.name: OLATB

provenance.notes: Hand-authored seed entry, not machine-extracted. Transcribed for IOCON.BANK = 0, the power-on default; the BANK = 1 address map is not covered. Check against the datasheet before trusting it, then mark it verified.
